questions.question: The National Literacy Mission (NLM) was set up in ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1988.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** National Literacy Mission **(NLM) was set up in **1988.**
 
• It was launched by the Government of India with the aim to** eradicate illiteracy **and provide** functional literacy **to non-literates.
 
• The mission has been successful in **reducing the overall illiteracy rate** in the country from** 52.21% in 1991 to 26.67% in 2011.**
 
• The NLM has also been instrumental in **promoting adult education, women's education**, and** education for marginalized sections **of society.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The National Literacy Mission is one of the** largest adult education programs** in the world.
 
• The NLM aims to** impart functional literacy to non-literates** in the age group of **15-35 years.**
 
• The mission has been successful in establishing **1.3 million adult education** centers across the country.
 
• The NLM has also been successful in promoting the use of technology in** education,** with the introduction of programs like the **Computer Literacy Program (CLP) and the Interactive Radio Instruction (IRI) program.**

questions.question: Which Sultan was defeated by Babur in the first battle of Panipat 1526?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Ibrahim Lodi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ibrahim Lodi **was the** Sultan** who was **defeated by Babur **in the **first battle of Panipat in 1526.**
 
• This battle marked the beginning of the **Mughal Empire** in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sikandar Lodi **was the** father of Ibrahim Lodi **and ruled the Delhi Sultanate before him.
 
• Ibrahim Lodi's brother, Mahmud Lodi, declared himself Sultan and continued to resist Mughal forces. He provided around 4,000 Afghan soldiers to Rana Sanga in the Battle of Khanwa in 1527. After that defeat, Mahmud Lodi fled eastwards and again posed a challenge to Babur two years later at the Battle of Ghaghra in 1529.
 
• **Bahlul Lodi** was the** founder of the Lodi dynasty **and ruled the **Delhi Sultanate** before Sikandar Lodi.

questions.question: Which among the following minerals is essential for the synthesis of thyroid hormones (thyroxine)?

• **Iodine** is an essential mineral required for the **synthesis of thyroxine.**
 
• Without sufficient iodine, the thyroid gland cannot produce enough thyroxine, leading to** hypothyroidism.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Iron:**

 
 
• Iron is required for the formation of **hemoglobin in red blood cells,** which carry oxygen to the body's tissues.
 
• Iron deficiency can lead to** anemia,** which causes **fatigue, weakness, and other symptoms.**
 
 
 
• **Selenium:**
 
 
• Selenium is a trace mineral that acts as an **antioxidant **and helps to maintain the health of the **immune system**, among other functions.
 
 
 
• **Chromium:**
 
 
• Chromium is a trace mineral that helps to **regulate blood sugar levels** and may have a role in weight management.

questions.question: The reign of Kumaragupta I the son and successor of ________ was one of peace and relative inactivity.
questions.solution:

__
 
• **Kumaragupta I** was the son and successor of **Chandragupta II.**
 
• Kumaragupta I's reign was marked by **peace and relative inactivity**, which was a result of the **stability and prosperity** achieved during the reign of his father, **Chandragupta II.**
 
• Chandragupta II, also known as **Vikramaditya,** was one of the **most powerful kings **of the **Gupta dynasty.**

• He is known for his** military victories** against the Huns.
 
 
 
• **Samudragupta,** also known as the **Napoleon of India**, was the predecessor of Kumaragupta I and ruled during a period of** great expansion and military conquest.**
 
 
• He is known for his **military campaigns** and **patronage of the arts.**

questions.question: Which Indian ministry introduced the Farm Laws Repeal Bill, 2021?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Agriculture undefined Farmers Welfare.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Farm Laws Repeal Bill, 2021**, was introduced in the **Lok Sabha **(lower house of the Indian Parliament) on** 22nd November 2021**, by the** Union Agriculture Minister, Narendra Singh Tomar.**
 
• The Bill seeks to repeal the **three contentious farm laws** that were enacted in September 2020, amidst widespread protests by farmers across the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The three farm laws that are proposed to be repealed are the **Farmers' Produce Trade and Commerce (Promotion and Facilitation) Act, 2020, the Farmers (Empowerment and Protection) Agreement on Price Assurance and Farm Services Act, 2020, and the Essential Commodities (Amendment) Act, 2020.**
 
• The Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Rural Development, and Ministry of Panchayati Raj are **not directly** related to the introduction of the Farm Laws Repeal Bill, 2021.

questions.question: Which of the following is the instrument of monetary policy used by the RBI?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Bank rate.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** instrument of monetary policy **used by the RBI is the **Bank rate.**
 
• Bank rate is the rate at which** RBI lends money to commercial banks** for meeting their liquidity needs.
 
• This rate is used by RBI to influence the** lending rates of commercial banks **and thereby control the money supply in the economy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Base rate** is the** minimum rate **below which banks** cannot lend **to their customers and is determined by individual banks based on their **cost of funds.**

 
 
• It is **not **a tool of monetary policy used by RBI.
 
 
 
• **Call rate **is the rate at which banks** borrow funds from each other** for short periods of time and is used for managing their day-to-day liquidity needs.
 
 
• It is **not **a tool of monetary policy used by RBI.
 
 
 
• **Discount rate** is the rate at which commercial banks can** borrow money from RBI** by pledging their securities as collateral.
 
 
• It is **not** a commonly used tool of monetary policy by RBI.

questions.question: In which of the following regions, a cyclone is known as "Typhoon"?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Japan.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A** typhoon **is a type of **tropical cyclone** that occurs in the **northwestern Pacific Ocean**, specifically in the region around **Japan.**
 
• Typhoons are known for their **strong winds, heavy rain**, and potential for **destructive storm surges.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In** India**, **cyclones **are typically referred to as "cyclonic storms" or "severe cyclonic storms."
 
• **Canada and Brazil **are not typically associated with tropical cyclones, but they may experience other types of storms such as** hurricanes or typhoons** in other regions of the world.
 
• It is important to note that typhoons, hurricanes, and cyclones are all essentially the same type of storm, but are given** different names **depending on the region in which they occur.

questions.question: The Ganesh-rath is one of the finest monolithic temples located in _______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahabalipuram.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Ganesh-rath** is located in** Mahabalipuram, **a town in the state of **Tamil Nadu** in India.
 
• It is a **monolithic temple**, which means it is carved out of a **single piece of rock.**
 
• The temple is dedicated to **Lord Ganesh**, who is worshipped as the god of **wisdom, knowledge, and new beginnings.**
 
• The Ganesh-rath is considered to be one of the finest examples of **Pallava architecture,** which flourished in southern India in the** 7th and 8th centuries AD.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Somnath** is a town in the state of Gujarat and is known for the **Somnath temple**, which is one of the **12 Jyotirlingas **(sacred abodes of Lord Shiva) in India.
 
• **Varanasi,** also known as **Kashi,** is a city in the northern state of Uttar Pradesh and is considered to be one of the **oldest continuously **inhabited cities in the world.
 
• **Nagpur** is a city in the **central state of Maharashtra **and is known for its oranges and as the geographical center of India.

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of micronutrient supplied by soil?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Iron.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Iron** is a **micronutrient** that is essential for **plant growth and development.**
 
• It is typically found in the soil in small amounts and is taken up by plants through their **roots.**
 
• Iron plays a key role in the **production of chlorophyll**, which is necessary for** photosynthesis.**
 
• Iron deficiencies in plants can lead to **stunted growth, chlorosis **(yellowing of the leaves), and **reduced yield.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Potassium (K)** is an essential nutrient for plant growth. It's classified as a **macronutrient** because plants take up large quantities of K during their life cycle.
 
• **Calcium** is a macronutrient that is needed in large amounts by plants **for cell wall structure** and other functions.
 
• **Sulphur** is also a macronutrient that is important for** amino acid and protein synthesis** in plants.

questions.question: Who is the author of the tragic story, "Othello"?

__

• **"Othello"** is one of Shakespeare's most famous tragedies, believed to have been written in **1603.**
 
• The play tells the story of a **Moorish general, Othello**, who is manipulated by his jealous and deceitful ensign, Iago, into believing that his wife, Desdemona, has been **unfaithful.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **William Wordsworth **was a Romantic poet who lived in the late** 18th and early 19th centuries**.

 
 
• He is known for his nature poetry and is often associated with the** Lake District in England.**
 
 
 
• **Johannes Gutenberg **was a **German inventor **who is credited with inventing the **printing press **in the 15th century.
 
 
• This invention revolutionized the **production of books** and helped to spread knowledge and information more widely.
 
 
 
• **Charles Dickens** was a 1**9th-century English novelist** who wrote many famous works, including** "Oliver Twist," "David Copperfield," and "A Tale of Two Cities."**

questions.question: The festival of Holika Dahan marks the ________.
questions.solution:

• **Holika Dahan** is a** Hindu festival** celebrated on the **full moon day** in the** Hindu month of Phalguna.**
 
• It marks the victory of **good over evil** as it symbolizes the** burning of the demoness Holika,** who tried to kill Prahlad, a devotee of Lord Vishnu.
 
• This festival is also known as **Chhoti Holi**, as it is celebrated a day before the main festival of Holi.
 
• Holika Dahan is celebrated by **lighting a bonfire** and performing rituals around it.
 
• This festival is celebrated with **great enthusiasm** and is a symbol of** hope and positivity.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Durga Puja **is celebrated in the month of **October or November.**

questions.question: India shares its boundary with which of the following countries in the east of West Bengal?

• India shares its boundary with **Bangladesh** in the **east of West Bengal.**
 
• The **Benapole-Petrapole border ceremony** is held every day from **4.30 to 5 pm **at the** India-Bangladesh border** by the **Border Security Force** of India and the **Border Guards of Bangladesh.**
 
• Civilians may access it **without a ticket** or other special authorization.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• India shares its boundary with **Pakistan** in the **northwestern region.**
 
• India shares its boundary with** China** in the **northeastern region. **
 
• India shares its boundary with** Afghanistan** in the **northwestern region.**

questions.question: Badruddin Tyabji addressed the congress as president in ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1887.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Badruddin Tyabji** was the** third president** of the **Indian National Congress.**
 
• He was a prominent lawyer and a member of the** Bombay Bar Association.**
 
• He presided over the **Congress session in 1887**, which was held in** Madras (now Chennai).**
 
• During his presidency, he emphasized the** need for unity** among different communities and regions in India.
 
• Tyabji played a significant role in the** Indian independence movement** and was a supporter of the Swadeshi movement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 1888: The fourth session of the Indian National Congress was held at Allahabad under the presidency of George Yule, who became the first Englishman to preside over the Congress.
 
• 1885: The first session of the Indian National Congress was held at Bombay under the presidency of Womesh Chandra Bonnerjee. It marked the formal beginning of the national political movement in India.
 
• 1886: The second session of the Congress was held at Calcutta under the presidency of Dadabhai Naoroji, an important nationalist leader known as the “Grand Old Man of India”.

questions.question: When the litmus solution is neither acidic nor basic, its colour is _______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**purple.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Litmus solution** is an indicator that **changes color** in response to the **pH leve**l of a substance.
 
• When the litmus solution is **neutral,** meaning it has a **pH of 7,** its color is **purple.**
 
• If the litmus solution turns **red**, it indicates that the substance is** acidic **with a **pH below 7.**
 
• If the litmus solution turns **blue**, it indicates that the substance is **basic **with a **pH above 7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Litmus paper **is another form of **litmus indicator** that is commonly used in laboratories and classrooms.
 
• **Red litmus paper** turns **blue in basic solutions** and **blue litmus paper turns red** in acidic solutions.
 
• **Purple litmus paper **is used to test for **neutral substances **and does not change color in either acidic or basic solutions.

questions.question: ________ poses are depicted on the gopurams of the Chidambaram temple (Tamil Nadu).
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatnatyam.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bharatnatyam poses** are depicted on the** gopurams** of the **Chidambaram temple (Tamil Nadu).**
 
• Bharatnatyam is a **classical Indian dance** form that originated in** Tamil Nadu **and is known for its** expressive and intricate movements.**
 
• **Kathak **is another classical Indian dance form that originated in** North India **and is known for its** fast footwork** and **storytelling **through dance.
 
• **Kathakali** is a traditional **dance-drama form from Kerala **that involves elaborate costumes, makeup, and facial expressions to tell stories from Hindu mythology.
 
• **Mohiniyattam** is a **classical dance form **from Kerala that is characterized by **graceful movements and facial expressions** that convey emotions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** Chidambaram temple** is one of the **oldest and most revered temples** in Tamil Nadu, dedicated to **Lord Shiva.**
 
• The **gopurams or entrance towers** of the temple are adorned with **intricate carvings and sculptures **that depict various scenes from Hindu mythology, including Bharatnatyam poses.
 
• Bharatnatyam is one of the most **popular classical dance forms** in India and is known for its emphasis on grace, precision, and storytelling through dance.
 
• The dance form has its roots in the **Natya Shastra, **an ancient Indian text that outlines the principles of **dance, music, and drama.**

questions.question: Which freedom fighter was also the first woman to become the Governor of Uttar Pradesh State?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Sarojini Naidu.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sarojini Naidu** was a **freedom fighter** and **social activist** who played a key role in India's struggle for **independence.**
 
• She was also the first woman to become the** Governor of Uttar Pradesh, **serving from **1947 to 1949.**
 
• Naidu was known as the **Nightingale of India **for her **poetry and literary works.**
 
• She was a **close associate of Mahatma Gandhi **and participated in various movements such as the **Non-Cooperation Movement **and the **Salt Satyagraha.**
 
• Naidu was also a prominent member of the **Indian National Congress **and served as its **President in 1925.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rajkumari Amrit Kaur **was a **freedom fighter and social reformer **who played a significant role in the Indian independence movement.

 
 
• She was the **first Health Minister of India **and also served as the** President of the All India Women's Conference.**
 
 
 
• **Rani Lakshmi Bai, **also known as the Queen of Jhansi, was a **warrior and freedom fighter **who fought against the British during the** Indian Rebellion of 1857.**
 
 
• She is remembered for her** bravery and sacrifice** in the face of adversity.
 
 
 
• **Kasturba Gandhi** was the **wife of Mahatma Gandhi **and actively participated in various movements for India's independence.
 
 
• She was also a **social activist **and worked towards the **empowerment of women **and the** upliftment of the underprivileged sections** of society.
